simple.meaning: אֵבֶר (ʼêber) is a Hebrew word meaning “a pinion.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אֵבֶר (H83) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 55:7, with occurrences in Psalms, Isaiah, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֵבֶר (H83) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אֵבֶר (H83) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אֵבֶר (ʼêber) / H83 is traced through Psalms 55:7, Isaiah 40:31, Ezekiel 17:3 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
